entities.name: One Country on Each Side
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: One Country on Each Side is a concept articulated in the Democratic Progressive Party government led by Chen Shui-bian, the former president of the Republic of China (2000–2008), regarding the political status of Taiwan. It emphasizes that the People's Republic of China and the Republic of China are two different countries,, as opposed to two separate political entities within the same country of "China". This is the position of the supporters of the Pan-Green coalition.
